decisionsTitle: A runner entered by hand stands by name in the public ranking once the staff record that they agreed
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-17 (~19:15)**, answering the question the results work raised («a typed runner — a bib no registration holds — is never named on the public page, because no staff member may tick for a runner; a guest who really wants a name there cannot have one. Is that right?»): «ar trebui să-l putem adăuga totuși în sistem manual, chiar dacă e adăugat de mână, să-l punem în rezultat». A runner added by hand («Adaugă un alergător neînscris»: number, name, sex, birth date) must be able to stand **by name** in the public ranking.

**Amends** the decision *Race results, part 1: entered or imported by race number, ranked, published only when the notice says so* (the same batch): that decision refused «a name for a typed runner on the public page (no staff-given consent)» and said a typed runner is never named. It is now named, under the rule below. Everything else in it stands — in particular a **registered** runner's name still follows only their own tick on the form.

**Decision.** The house's rule does not move: a public list is a disclosure, and a name shows only for a person who agreed (§143, §396, `CLAUDE.md`'s unbreakable row). For a registered runner the agreement is their own tick. For a runner typed by hand there is no form, and the house already has the shape for that: the race-day desk's **paper declaration**, which the *participant* signs and a staff member *records*, the audit naming who recorded it (§67, BR-REQ-037-05). So **a typed runner is named in the public ranking only while the staff ticked, on their line, that the person agreed to appear by name — recorded, audited (who, when), off by default; without it «Participant #bib», as before.** The dispatcher's decision, taken on the owner's answer. **It differs from the paper declaration in one thing, and counsel is asked about it:** there the participant signs and the signature is the proof; here the person's agreement is an oral statement and the only evidence is the staff member's record (who, when). Two questions for the lawyer, with the new sentence: whether that record alone is enough proof of consent (GDPR art. 7(1)), and whether the person is informed (art. 13) by the staff pointing to the privacy notice.

**The data** (migration `0167_event_results_name_agreed`, an expand: two nullable columns). `event_results.name_agreed_at` (a timestamp rather than a boolean, so «when» is on the row) and `name_agreed_by_staff_user_id` (`ON DELETE SET NULL`; the audit row names who too). Three checks, all at the database: the mark exists **only on a row no registration holds** (`registration_id IS NULL` — a registered runner's name follows their own tick, never a staff mark, and a typed row a registration later takes over loses it in the same save); a mark needs **a name to show** (`display_name IS NOT NULL`); and the actor is set **only with the moment**. The brief asked that the two be set together; `ON DELETE SET NULL` makes that impossible (removing a staff account must leave the agreement standing, naming nobody), so the check is the one-way form.

**The rule** (`publicResultName`, still the one pure function the page, the backoffice preview and the public read share). It gains `typedNameAgreed` and `typedDisplayName`: a row with **no registration** is named when the mark is set, the typed name is not blank, **and a privacy notice that describes the results is in force** (`firstResultsNoticeVersion` is not null). The agreement is honoured from the first notice that describes the results, whenever it was recorded: nothing is published before such a notice, and the tick's own words («A acceptat să apară cu numele în clasament») are an agreement to exactly this disclosure, so no version check like the registered tick's is needed; a registered row ignores the mark entirely. `readPublicEventResults` selects the two columns and passes them — and passes the mark **only for a row whose number no confirmed registration holds**: when the desk gives a confirmed registration the number of an agreed typed row, the backoffice already draws the line as the registered runner's and their own tick answers, so until the next «Salvează tot» re-files the row the public line is «Participant #bib», never the typed name on a bib a registered runner holds; its rows keep their shape (`name | null`), so nothing about the page lane changes, and no agreement, moment or actor ever reaches the public.

**The line.** Under each stored typed line, in the registered lines' own caption, the page says what the site will print for it («Pe site: Participant #900» or «Pe site: cu numele», from `publicResultName`), so a tick saved while no notice describes the results does not look as if it names anybody. On each typed line of `/admin/events/[id]/results`, a real tick box (`CheckboxField`, never a toggle button) «A acceptat să apară cu numele în clasament», with «Bifezi doar dacă persoana ți-a spus-o; pentru un minor, părintele sau tutorele. Cine a bifat și când rămân în jurnal.»; it is posted with the line (`n[<i>].agreed`) and comes back as posted after a refusal (§315). A registered line draws none and a forged `r[..].agreed` is ignored. **Who:** every role that may enter results (`canEnterResults`: the Organizer, the Administrator, the Superadministrator), as at the desk a paper declaration is recorded by every staff role; the Tehnic role and the volunteer are refused by the service. **The save** («Salvează tot clasamentul», one transaction) sets `name_agreed_at = now()` and the actor when the tick turns on, clears both when it turns off, and leaves both as they were when it stays on — a correction of the time does not rewrite who recorded the agreement. **A new name beside a tick that stays on, and a changed number on an agreed line, are recorded again by whoever saves them** (the moment and the actor are theirs, `changed` names `name` and `nameAgreed`, `nameAgreed: true`), so a different person is never published under the first person's recorded agreement. A tick on a line with no name is a refused row (`agreedNameMissing`, the first invalid row refuses all) with its own sentence; a tick alone on an otherwise empty line is no row. A CSV never carries an agreement, and a number it adds starts a new line unticked (a ticked empty line is never handed to an imported number: the tick would be another person's). The agreement's moment is part of the stored rows' fingerprint, so a form drawn before a colleague ticked or unticked the line is refused with CONFLICT.

**The trail.** `event_result.created` / `.updated` carry `nameAgreed: true|false` when the agreement was recorded or withdrawn (`changed` names `nameAgreed`), under the audit row's actor and moment — **never the name**, the lane's audit rule. A withdrawal is as easy as the recording: the tick comes off and the next read shows «Participant #bib»; the notice also says the agreement can be withdrawn by writing to the club.

**The notice.** The privacy notice template's `{{results}}` paragraph (section 4) also says that a runner who did not register and whose time the organizers entered by hand appears by name only if they told the organizers so (otherwise «Participant #numărul de concurs»), that for a minor it is the parent or guardian who tells the organizers (the notice's own rule that only they give a minor's consent), that the organizers record the agreement in the log with who recorded it and when, and that the runner (or the guardian) can withdraw it at any time (consent, art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), in both languages. The notice's `{{results}}` merge field, the `resultsNotice` row on `/admin/tasks` and the gate are unchanged: no notice describing the results is in force anywhere yet, so approving the notice once from the new template covers the registered and the typed. **The terms' template changes in the one sentence that said who is named** (section 7): it now says the name is shown, among those registered, only for those who ticked the same words, the other registered runners appearing without a name, and that someone who did not register but was entered by the organizers appears by name only if they said they want to, as the notice describes — so the two texts do not contradict each other. The quoted clause the gate keys on is untouched. No terms describing the results are in force anywhere, so this costs no extra approval. **A lawyer reads the new sentences** with the rest of section 4 and the terms' section 7. **Release order:** the typed branch is gated like the registered one on `{{results}}` alone, so this lane ships in the same release as the results work it amends (`feat/race-results-v1`), and no notice from that lane's template alone may be approved before then.

**Retention and erasure.** The sweep deletes a race's results three years after the race **whole rows at a time**, so a typed name and its agreement (moment, actor) go together; nothing is cleared on its own. «Toate datele unei persoane» does not read typed rows (no registration) and needs nothing.

**Elsewhere in the documents.** BUSINESS.md BR-BUS-072 gains the exception (a runner entered by hand is named only on a staff-recorded agreement, audited, a guardian for a minor; a registered participant's choice never replaced) and AGENTS.md §10.10 names it beside the public list's rules. `tests/privacy/public-surface.test.ts` now pins the path of the typed name (selected once, beside the mark, reaching a row only through `publicResultName`) and the real read's null name for an unmarked typed row.

**Refused.** A staff mark on a registered runner (their name stays their own tick's); a name shown without a recorded agreement, or while no approved notice describes the results; a tick that carries no name; an agreement in a CSV; a second verb or a new role for it; clearing the name and the agreement as separate steps of the sweep; and showing the public who recorded it or when.
changelogLine: - **A runner entered by hand can stand by name in the ranking** — on «Clasament», a typed runner's line has a tick «A acceptat să apară cu numele în clasament» (for a minor, the parent or guardian told you); ticked by whoever enters results (who and when are kept in the log, never the name; a new name on the line is recorded again by whoever saves it), the public ranking shows the typed name, otherwise «Participant #număr»; the line says what the site will print for it; the privacy notice's and the terms' templates say so (migration `0167`). §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a runner the club entered by hand in a race's results (no registration holds the number), when the public read returns the results, then the typed name is shown only while a staff member has recorded on that line that the person agreed to appear by name (`name_agreed_at`), the name is not blank and a privacy notice that describes the results is in force, and no confirmed registration holds the number; otherwise the row is «Participant #bib»; a registered runner is named by their own «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» tick alone and a staff mark on their row means nothing; taking the tick off takes the name off the next read; and the read still carries no agreement, moment, actor, note or registration id (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). A new name beside a tick that stays on is recorded again by whoever saves it. Verification: privacy `public-surface.test.ts`, unit `results/public-name.test.ts`, integration `results/typed-name.test.ts`, `results/results.test.ts`.

Given a race's «Clasament» page, when an Organizer or an Administrator ticks «A acceptat să apară cu numele în clasament» on a line of a runner entered by hand and presses «Salvează tot clasamentul», then the moment and the staff member are recorded with the line (left as they were while it stays ticked, cleared when it is taken off), one audit row names the change (`nameAgreed`) and never the name, a registered runner's line has no such tick and a forged one is ignored, a tick on a line with no name refuses the save with its own sentence while every box keeps what was typed (the tick included), a new name beside a ticked line re-stamps the record and the trail, the line says what the site will print for it, a CSV import adds its new lines unticked, a form older than another session's tick is refused with CONFLICT, and the database refuses the mark on a row a registration holds (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/typed-name.test.ts`, `results/page.test.ts`, unit `results/row-input.test.ts`, `results/typed-line-recall.test.ts`, `results/rows-and-merge.test.ts`, e2e `race-results.spec.ts`.

batchLine: race results: a runner entered by hand stands by name in the public ranking once the staff record that they agreed
